messages.content: Hello ARC Prize team, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is released under the Qwen Community License 1.0, which permits use, modification and redistribution but is not OSI-approved. The Kaggle rules require open-source models and weights (Winner License §5.a), while §5.a.3 says no open-source licence is required for "pretrained models with an incompatible license". arcprize.org asks that third-party components be available under an open-source licence allowing public sharing. Could you confirm whether a pretrained base model under the Qwen Community License is acceptable for prize eligibility under the §5.a.3 exemption, provided all submitter-authored code is released under CC0 or MIT-0? Thank you.
